lesson.title: 第十五課：我很不舒服

dialogues.title: 對話一：白如玉在看醫生
dialogues.content:
醫生：白小姐，妳哪裡不舒服？
如玉：我一直流鼻水，頭很痛，胃口很差。什麼東西都不想吃。
醫生：大概多久了？
如玉：已經四、五天了。
醫生：我看看妳的喉嚨。喉嚨有一點發炎。
如玉：請問我生的是什麼病？
醫生：妳有一點發燒，是感冒，不過沒有什麼關係。
如玉：請問我得吃藥嗎？
醫生：要，妳到藥局去拿藥。
如玉：好的。請問我的病什麼時候會好？
醫生：回去把藥吃了，多喝水，多休息，早一點睡覺，很快就會好。
如玉：好的，謝謝您。
dialogues.content_py:
Yīshēng：Bái Xiǎojiě, nǐ nǎlǐ bù shūfú?
Rúyù：Wǒ yìzhí liú bíshuǐ, tóu hěn tòng, wèikǒu hěn chā. Shénme dōngxi dōu bù xiǎng chī.
Yīshēng：Dàgài duō jiǔ le?
Rúyù：Yǐjīng sì, wǔtiān le.
Yīshēng：Wǒ kànkàn nǐ de hóulóng. Hóulóng yǒu yìdiǎn fāyán.
Rúyù：Qǐngwèn wǒ shēng de shì shénme bìng?
Yīshēng：Nǐ yǒu yìdiǎn fāshāo, shì gǎnmào, búguò méi yǒu shénme guānxi.
Rúyù：Qǐngwèn wǒ děi chī yào ma?
Yīshēng：Yào, nǐ dào yàojú qù ná yào.
Rúyù：Hǎode. Qǐngwèn wǒ de bìng shénme shíhòu huì hǎo?
Yīshēng：Huíqù bǎ yào chīle, duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxí, zǎo yìdiǎn shuìjiào, hěn kuài jiù huì hǎo.
Rúyù：Hǎode, xièxie nín.
dialogues.content_en:
Doctor：Miss Bai, how are you doing? (Where are you feeling poorly?)
Ruyu：My nose continues to run, my head aches, and my appetite is poor. I don't feel like eating anything.
Doctor：About how long?
Ruyu：About four or five days now.
Doctor：Let me take a look at your throat. Your throat is a bit inflamed.
Ruyu：Excuse me, what sickness do I have?
Doctor：You have a slight fever. It's a cold, but it's nothing serious.
Ruyu：Excuse me, do I have to take any medicine?
Doctor：Yes. Go to the pharmacy to pick up your medicine.
Ruyu：Thank you. Excuse me, when will I be well again?
Doctor：Go home, take your medicine, drink plenty of water, get plenty of rest, and go to bed early and you'll be better very soon.
Ruyu：Fine, thank you.

dialogues.title: 對話二：如玉關心安同的身體狀況
dialogues.content:
如玉：你怎麼了？臉色這麼難看。
安同：昨天晚上肚子很不舒服，吃了東西就吐，還吐了好幾次。
如玉：你這麼不舒服，我陪你去看病，好不好？
安同：不用了。我在臺灣沒有健康保險。
如玉：那麼，我陪你去學校的健康中心。那裡的醫生很好，對學生也很客氣。
安同：謝謝妳。我想去藥局買藥就好了。
如玉：你真的不去看病嗎？
安同：我想回家休息。請妳跟老師說，我生病了，不能上課。
如玉：好。你自己要多小心。油的、冰的東西最好都別吃。
安同：謝謝妳的關心。
（如玉下課以後）
如玉：我來看你了。現在覺得怎麼樣？好一點了嗎？
安同：謝謝妳，好多了。我吃了一包藥以後，睡得比昨天好。
如玉：不錯。你睡了幾個小時的覺以後，現在臉色比早上好得多了。
dialogues.content_py:
Rúyù：Nǐ zěnme le? Liǎnsè zhème nánkàn.
Āntóng：Zuótiān wǎnshàng dùzi hěn bù shūfú, chīle dōngxi jiù tù, hái tùle hǎo jǐ cì.
Rúyù：Nǐ zhème bù shūfú, wǒ péi nǐ qù kànbìng, hǎo bù hǎo?
Āntóng：Búyòng le. Wǒ zài Táiwān méi yǒu jiànkāng bǎoxiǎn.
Rúyù：Nàme, wǒ péi nǐ qù xuéxiào de jiànkāng zhōngxīn. Nàlǐ de yīshēng hěn hǎo, duì xuéshēng yě hěn kèqì.
Āntóng：Xièxie nǐ. Wǒ xiǎng qù yàojú mǎi yào jiù hǎo le.
Rúyù：Nǐ zhēnde bú qù kànbìng ma?
Āntóng：Wǒ xiǎng huí jiā xiūxí. Qǐng nǐ gēn lǎoshī shuō, wǒ shēngbìng le, bù néng shàngkè.
Rúyù：Hǎo. Nǐ zìjǐ yào duō xiǎoxīn. Yóu de, bīng de dōngxi zuìhǎo dōu bié chī.
Āntóng：Xièxie nǐ de guānxīn.
（Rúyù xiàkè yǐhòu）
Rúyù：Wǒ lái kàn nǐ le. Xiànzài juéde zěnmeyàng? Hǎo yìdiǎn le ma?
Āntóng：Xièxie nǐ, hǎo duō le. Wǒ chīle yì bāo yào yǐhòu, shuì de bǐ zuótiān hǎo.
Rúyù：Búcuò. Nǐ shuìle jǐ ge xiǎoshí de jiào yǐhòu, xiànzài liǎnsè bǐ zǎoshàng hǎo de duō le.
dialogues.content_en:
Ruyu：What's the matter? You don't look too good.
Antong：My stomach didn't feel good last night. I ate something and then threw up. I vomited several times.
Ruyu：You're feeling that badly. I'll go with you to see a doctor. Okay?
Antong：No need. I don't have health insurance in Taiwan.
Ruyu：Then I'll go with you to the school's health center. The doctors there are good, and they are polite to students.
Antong：Thank you. I think I'll just buy some medicine at a drug store. That should do it.
Ruyu：You're really not going to see a doctor?
Antong：I just want to go home and rest. Please tell the teacher I am sick and I can't go to class.
Ruyu：Take care of yourself. You'd best not eat anything oily or cold.
Antong：Thank you for your concern.
（after Ruyu gets out of class）
Ruyu：I came to see you. How are you feeling now? Any better?
Antong：Thanks. Much better now. I took a packet of medicine and slept a lot better than yesterday.
Ruyu：Good. After having slept for a few hours, you now look much better than this morning.

grammar_points.title: I. Non-committal Stance with Question Words

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: Negative statement + question word

blocks.label: Function
blocks.text: When question words such as 什麼、多少、幾、哪裡、什麼地方、誰、什麼時候 occur in a declarative sentence, the sentence expresses a vague, non-committal attitude — the speaker avoids giving a clear answer.
blocks.ex:
我沒有多少錢。
她沒有幾個朋友。
你的感冒沒有什麼關係。
我沒去哪裡。
他不打算買什麼。
我昨天沒跟誰去看電影。

blocks.label: Restriction
blocks.text: Non-committal statements of this type are always in the negative. The question word does not ask a real question.

grammar_points.title: II. To Dispose of Something with 把

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: S + 把 + definite O + V + 了

blocks.label: Function
blocks.text: The 把 or disposal construction is similar to “take this (noun) and…” in English, but much more widely used. It refers to how a noun, the object of the action verb, is disposed of by the subject.
blocks.ex:
我把牛肉麵吃了。
他把我的湯喝了。
房東把房子賣了。

blocks.label: Structures
blocks.text: 把 + object + verb + 了. The object is in most cases definite (a bare noun, or a noun with a modifier such as 這個、那個、他的). The verb must be an outward transitive action verb, and the sentence must end with the particle 了.

blocks.label: Negation
blocks.text: The negation 沒 or 別 occurs in front of the particle 把.
blocks.ex:
我沒把豬腳麵線吃了。
別把我的藥吃了。
他沒把書賣了。

blocks.label: Questions
blocks.text: Use 了沒有 or 是不是 to form questions.
blocks.ex:
你把功課寫了沒有？
你是不是把機車賣了？
你是不是把他的早飯吃了？

blocks.label: Usage
blocks.text: The object of 把 must be definite: 我想把那支手機賣了 is fine, 我想把一支手機賣了 is not. The bare verb must be outward and transitive — 賣、吃、喝、寫 — but not inward verbs such as 買、學; 我把中文學了 is incorrect.
blocks.ex:
我想把手機賣了。
我想把那支手機賣了。

grammar_points.title: III. V 了…就… do…right after doing…

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: Event 1: V + 了，就 + Event 2

blocks.label: Function
blocks.text: The pattern V 了…就… indicates that event 2 occurs right after the completion of event 1.
blocks.ex:
我放了假就去旅行。
他吃了藥就睡覺。
爸爸回了家就喝了兩杯烏龍茶。

blocks.label: Structures
blocks.text: The two events can be in the affirmative or in the negative.
blocks.ex:
他到了臺北，就去臺北 101 看看。
妹妹喝了一碗熱湯，就不覺得冷了。
姐姐吃了臭豆腐，肚子就不舒服。

blocks.label: Questions
blocks.text: The A-not-A form is not possible. Either 嗎 or 是不是 can be used to form questions.
blocks.ex:
他們見了面，就去喝咖啡嗎？
你弟弟是不是下了課，就去 KTV 唱歌？
他是不是去紐約玩了兩個星期，就不想回來了？

blocks.label: Usage
blocks.text: 以後 can be used with V 了…就…, but it cannot be used with the 一…就… pattern of Lesson 13.
blocks.ex: 他吃了藥以後，就去睡覺。

grammar_points.title: IV. Minimal Quantity or Degree with 一點

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: 一點

blocks.label: Function
blocks.text: The combination 一點 indicates a minimal quantity or degree.
blocks.ex:
他喝了一點咖啡。
這一點錢太少了。
她要吃一點麵線。

blocks.label: 一點 + NP
blocks.text: Before a noun, as its modifier, 一點 indicates a small quantity.
blocks.ex:
她在超市買了一點東西。
我只喝了一點烏龍茶。
昨天下了一點雨。

blocks.label: Vs + 一點
blocks.text: After a state verb, 一點 indicates comparison, as in “a little more/less…”.
blocks.ex:
他比我年輕一點。
請你早一點來！
明天我會晚一點回家。

blocks.label: 有（一）點 + Vs
blocks.text: Before a state verb but preceded by 有, it expresses a slight subjective feeling and does not indicate comparison.
blocks.ex:
牛肉麵有一點辣。
這裡，冬天有一點冷。
這支手機有一點貴。
他有（一）點想睡。

blocks.label: Usage
blocks.text: 一點 can be reduplicated to form 一點點, indicating “just a tiny bit”, e.g. 我只要一點點。

grammar_points.title: V. Comparing Actions with a 得 Complement

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: A + 比 + B + V + 得 + State

blocks.label: Function
blocks.text: This pattern compares how two people perform an action.
blocks.ex:
哥哥吃牛肉麵吃得比弟弟多。
這種手機賣得比那種好。

blocks.label: Structure 1
blocks.text: Comparative + Action + 得 + State.
blocks.ex:
他比我做得快。
我比他走得快。
弟弟比哥哥念得好。

blocks.label: Structure 2
blocks.text: Action + 得 + Comparative + State, with the verb repeated when there is an object. This pattern is used most frequently.
blocks.ex:
他做飯做得比我快。
我走路走得比他快。
弟弟念書念得比哥哥好。

blocks.label: Negation
blocks.text: The negation marker 不 precedes 比.
blocks.ex:
他做飯不比我做得快。
走路，我不比他走得快。
弟弟念書念得不比哥哥好。

blocks.label: Questions
blocks.text: Ask with 嗎 or with 是不是.
blocks.ex:
你做飯做得比媽媽好嗎？
他是不是走路走得比你快？
弟弟打網球打得比哥哥好嗎？

grammar_points.title: VI. Complements of Degree in Comparison Structures

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: A + 比 + B + Vs + 一點／得多／多了

blocks.label: Function
blocks.text: The amount of difference is placed after the state verb: 一點 for a small difference, 得多 or 多了 for a large one.
blocks.ex:
他的房間比我的大一點。
捷運站比公車站遠得多。
我覺得晚上比早上舒服多了。

blocks.label: Questions
blocks.text: Ask with 是不是 or 嗎.
blocks.ex:
哥哥是不是比弟弟高一點？
房租可以便宜一點嗎？
春天去旅行是不是比夏天舒服得多？
高鐵票比火車票貴多了嗎？

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: V + inserted element + N

blocks.label: Function
blocks.text: The inherent structure of most separable verbs is [V+N]. The V and N can be separated and an element inserted between them; the separated V and N then behave like a verb and an object. Examples: 唱歌、上班、上網、上課、生病、睡覺、看書、念書、滑雪、游泳、照相、吃飯、做飯、見面.

blocks.label: 了 inserted
blocks.text: The verbal 了 is inserted between the verb and the noun.
blocks.ex:
他回了家以後，就開始工作。
我昨天下了課就跟朋友去看電影。

blocks.label: Object inserted
blocks.text: The object refers to the recipient of the action.
blocks.ex:
我想見你一面。
他照了你一張相。

blocks.label: Duration inserted
blocks.text: A time-duration expression is inserted between the verb and the noun.
blocks.ex:
我們每天上八個鐘頭的班。
你們新年的時候，放幾天的假？
他唱了三小時的歌，有一點累。

lesson.activities:
I. Let's Compare 比一比
【目標 Goal】Learning to make comparisons of varying degrees.
【做法 Task】The four students below are learning Chinese in Taipei. They always eat together and go out together, but they don't live together. Compare the four using the items in the left-hand column.
【例】晚飯吃幾碗：田中 兩碗／如玉 一碗半／安同 兩碗半／月美 半碗。
房租：田中 NT$18,000／如玉 NT$6,500／安同 NT$15,000／月美 NT$6,200。
怎麼去臺南玩：田中 計程車（三個半小時）／如玉 火車（四個半小時）／安同 機車（八個小時）／月美 高鐵（一個小時四十分鐘）。

II. Who Is Taking Care of Me? 誰在照顧我？
【目標 Goal】Learning to ask how someone is feeling and giving suggestions to somebody who is sick.
【做法 Task 1】Play roles A and B with a classmate and write down your conversation. Practise both agreeing to a suggestion and refusing one.
【例】A：你怎麼了？
B：我喉嚨發炎。
A：你應該／最好……。（看病、多休息、早一點睡覺、多喝水）
B：好的，謝謝你的關心。
【做法 Task 2】Role-play as a patient. You vomited after dinner last night and your stomach is upset. You go to see a doctor; your partner role-plays the doctor. Describe your symptoms and let the doctor give advice.

III. Taking Medication 讀懂藥袋
【目標 Goal】Learning to read the instructions on prescriptions.
【做法 Task】Look at the medicine bag from the clinic and answer the three questions.
【例】這種藥一天吃幾次？（一天四次）
什麼時候吃？（飯後三十分鐘）
裡面有幾包藥？（依藥袋內容作答）

IV. Use 把 Construction 用「把」說說看
【目標 Goal】Learning to use the disposal construction 把.
【做法 Task】Form groups of two and complete the dialogues based on the pictures.
【例】A：加油！我們今天一定要＿＿這 50 個小籠包＿＿了。B：好的，沒有問題。
A：要是你＿＿今天的功課＿＿了，就可以去打籃球。B：太好了。
A：誰＿＿我的西瓜＿＿了？B：對不起，我不知道是你的。

V. How Are You Feeling? 你覺得怎麼樣？
【目標 Goal】Learning to talk about having a cold.
【做法 Task】Your friend 如玉 is sick at home. Call her, find out how she is feeling, and ask four questions about her condition.
lesson.culture:
臺灣的戴口罩文化 Wearing Surgical Masks
在臺灣，民眾戴口罩不一定表示生病。季節交替、流感流行或自己出現咳嗽與流鼻水時，許多人會戴口罩以降低呼吸道疾病傳播；在擁擠的大眾運輸上，也有人把口罩視為個人防護。機車騎士可能為了防風、防寒、灰塵與空氣污染而戴口罩；餐飲與醫療場所則常基於衛生與感染控制需要使用口罩。這項習慣也反映出保護自己並顧及他人的公共衛生觀念。

questions.instruction: Answer using a question word to show a non-committal attitude.
questions.prompt: 你的房租一個月多少錢？
週末快到了，你打算去哪裡玩？

questions.instruction: Complete using the V 了…就… pattern.
questions.prompt: 妹妹（喝）了熱湯，就不覺得冷了。
